scope: Evidence-bound composition of native direct UNRAVEL selected-serial semantics with retained C-Gate source routing and Reply Network correlation; no live physical bridge or site data

grounding.evidence: testdata/vectors/serial_address.jsonl direct selected-serial vectors and retained pci_serial_address oracle
grounding.finding: The native direct operation fixes the application 0xFF selected-serial SAL body 0F 00 <four serial bytes> <destination> <inner checksum>, the supported destination range 2..254, and its parameter-0 six-byte serial receipt.

The retained native C-Gate source-route envelope composes an unchanged application/SAL payload after destination type 0x03, first bridge, route length times nine, remaining bridges, and application. The evidenced route bound is one through six bridges.
Original Reply Network matching binds the first bridge, every remaining hop, the remote unit, and CAL selector. Direct or neighbouring-route replies cannot satisfy a routed target observation.

The complete-inventory planner and CBusBaseNetwork topology resolution are independent of the physical route. cmqttd retains the direct allocation rules while routing all target MMI, IDENTIFY, selected-serial receipt, per-move verification, and final inventory operations through one resolved CBusBaseNetwork path.

claimed_behavior: NET UNRAVEL, NET UNRAVELUNIT and DO UNRAVEL accept a complete unambiguous topology route of one through six bridges.

The planner resolves topology and validates selection before PCI I/O, proves complete known-serial inventory and every destination before the first mutation, and sends every selected-serial request exactly once outside replay.

A routed request completes only with its allocated positive confirmation and exactly one Reply Network receipt matching every bridge, the remote destination, parameter 0, and selected serial; movement then requires independent route-correlated IDENTIFY and final whole-target-network inventory.
Only the addressed network physical cache/state and staged events commit after an unchanged PCI-generation guard.
acceptance: Golden serial_address.jsonl vectors pin literal one- and six-bridge requests and invalid zero/seven-hop preflight.
Transport regressions pin exact Reply Network and serial matching, rejection of a neighbouring route, programming-lane retirement, and zero replay.
Service regression completes routed MATCHDB movement and proves the root-network cache is unchanged.
A real cmqttd daemon regression completes the one-bridge mutation through the shared simulated PCI and observes exactly one selected-serial frame.
limits: There is no retained native wire capture of a routed selected-serial UNRAVEL mutation. The request is a bounded composition of the retained native selected-serial payload with the retained native PPM source-route envelope.
No physical C-Bus bridge or remote unit completed this mutation in acceptance. Tests use protocol codecs and the simulated shared PCI.
The parameter-0 receipt is correlation evidence only. Success additionally requires volatile routed inventory; it does not prove nonvolatile address persistence or power-cycle survival.
Any uncertain write or incomplete correlated observation retires the programming/MMI lane and is never replayed automatically.
